product_launches.description: Bitso launched MXNB, a Mexican peso-pegged stablecoin that supports deposits and withdrawals on Base.

press_references.value: Ripple and Bitso Expand Stablecoin Settlement on XRP Ledger

product_launches.description: Bitso is issuing its MXN-backed stablecoin MXNB on the XRP Ledger and integrating it with Ripple’s Payments on DEX infrastructure, expanding regulated dollar-peso liquidity for enterprise cross-border payments on the U.S.-Mexico corridor.

press_references.value: MXNB Becomes the First Latin American Currency-Pegged Stablecoin Issued Under El Salvador's CNAD Regulation

product_launches.description: Bitso, through its licensed affiliate Nvio Pagos El Salvador, has launched regulated issuance and management of MXNB, a Mexican peso-pegged stablecoin, under El Salvador’s CNAD framework, making it the first Latin American currency-pegged stablecoin to operate under this regulation.

press_references.value: Bitso Accelerates Onchain Expansion With Upcoming Perps Aggregator and 2026 Token Launch

product_launches.description: Bitso announced the upcoming launch of its multi-platform Perps Aggregator, an onchain execution layer for perpetual futures trading, planned for early Q1 2026 as part of its onchain ecosystem expansion.

press_references.value: Bitso Lists Tether Gold, Bringing Tokenized Physical Gold to Crypto Users

product_launches.description: Bitso has launched support for trading Tether Gold (XAU₮) on its platform, giving users access to tokenized, gold-backed assets within its crypto offering.

press_references.value: Bitso Launches Global Stock Investing Platform

product_launches.description: Bitso launched Global Stocks, enabling clients in Mexico to buy and sell 5,000+ U.S. stocks and ETFs from a MX$20 minimum, 24/7, with immediate fund availability, no commissions, and funding in pesos or dollars; rollout begins via waitlist alongside a redesigned app and brand refresh across LATAM.

press_references.value: Bitso Launches Bitso OnChain, A Decentralized Exchange That Democratizes Access To The Crypto Ecosystem

product_launches.description: Bitso has launched Bitso Onchain, a decentralized exchange (DEX) that allows users to discover and trade over 17,000 tokens across 14 blockchains, aiming to democratize access to the crypto ecosystem.

press_references.value: Bitso to launch Mexican peso-pegged stablecoin on Arbitrum

product_launches.description: A stablecoin fully backed by Mexican pesos, issued and managed by Juno on the Arbitrum blockchain.

overview_description.description:
Bitso is a cryptocurrency exchange platform that allows users to buy and sell bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. Bitso specializes in the fields of bitcoin, fintech, and blockchain. Its platform enables its users to make payments using their mobile and other devices.

Bitso was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Mexico City, Distrito Federal.

about_short_description.short_description: Bitso is a cryptocurrency exchange platform that allows users to buy and sell bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.

product.name: Bitso Crypto Trading
product.description: A cryptocurrency exchange service for buying, selling, holding, depositing, withdrawing, and transferring more than 100 digital assets, including Bitcoin, Ether, XRP, and Solana.

product.name: Bitso Stocks
product.description: An investment service that lets customers access more than 5,000 international stocks and exchange-traded funds alongside their cryptocurrency holdings in the Bitso app.

product.name: Bitso Earnings
product.description: A yield service that allows customers to earn returns on eligible crypto assets, including USDC, USDT, ETH, DOT, ATOM, and SOL, without a lock-up period.

product.name: Bitso Transfers
product.description: A cross-border money movement service for sending funds internationally and receiving money locally through a Bitso account.

product.name: Bitso Alpha
product.description: A professional cryptocurrency trading platform that provides advanced tools for customers implementing more complex trading strategies.

product.name: Onchain by Bitso
product.description: An independent self-custody trading platform offering 24/7 access to more than 300 perpetual markets, subject to jurisdictional restrictions and trading risks.
